bootstrap_witnesses.implementation: Only done exists; full finite-horizon final slot/frame is done=True. There is no independent terminated/truncated field.
bootstrap_witnesses.truncation_bootstrap_allowed: No separate truncation path/flag exists; the finite-horizon episode boundary is represented as terminal and masks bootstrap.

static.done_fields: Transition dataclasses have a single done boolean and no independent terminated/truncated fields. Collector marks the final finite-horizon slot/frame done and uses zero next-observation placeholders; old_next_value is set to zero. GAE masks terminal bootstrap to zero.
static.duration_ppo_vs_gae: PPO evaluation uses stored duration_actions. compute_macro_smdp_gae uses batch durations (actual_duration), with gamma**duration and (gamma*lambda)**duration; terminal done masks next-value bootstrap and trace.
static.macro_batch_padding: _macro_batch writes each legal candidate descriptor and mask into [:count]; padding is appended only on the right. _tensor_batch indexes transition rows and does not index candidate axes.
static.macro_candidate_order: _cache_candidates appends feature rows in candidate list order; row prefix is the flattened full binary Cache configuration, followed by delta and changed-node fraction. Candidate 0 is copied current Cache. Candidate configurations are deduplicated by bytes.
static.macro_evaluate: evaluate_macro_components receives cache_actions and duration_actions from the batch; _macro_logits gathers the selected candidate row using cache_actions.
static.macro_gae_order: _update_macro calls _macro_batch, then compute_macro_smdp_gae(frame_rewards, old_values, old_next_values, actual durations, dones) before minibatch tensor conversion; _tensor_batch first receives all_indices in original order.
static.macro_selected_cache: frame_cache_index=selected.cache_index; frame_cache=_candidates[frame_cache_index].copy(); MacroTransition.cache_action stores frame_cache_index and cache_configuration_id stores SHA256(int8 Cache bytes)[:16]. Candidate feature rows are copied without reordering.
static.micro_autoregressive_condition: Rollout samples UAV0 with a zero condition, applies the selected candidate, normalizes the resulting UAV0 target position, then supplies that value to UAV1 and stores it in MicroTransition.uav0_position_condition. evaluate_micro_joint supplies zeros to head 0 and stored conditions to head 1.
static.micro_batch_and_evaluate: _micro_batch stacks actions/features/masks/conditions in Transition order; _tensor_batch only selects transition rows; evaluate_micro_joint receives those saved fields and verifies the selected action against the saved legal mask. PPO does not regenerate UAV candidates.
static.micro_candidate_order: _uav_candidates returns [stay, *moves] and emits corresponding features in the same loop. _pad_micro_candidates writes source rows into [:count] and leaves only tail padding. Positions use the same candidate list order; masks match this prefix.
static.micro_gae_order: _update_micro calls _micro_batch, then compute_gae(rewards, old_values, dones, 0.0) before np.random.permutation(count) and minibatch slicing.
static.requested_actual_duration: sample_macro duration_index maps through policy.duration_candidates to requested_duration; actual_duration_for_frame=min(requested, episode_slots-start_slot). MacroTransition stores both; _macro_batch stores requested_durations separately from actual durations under durations.
